description: Run a shell command on a remote server. A non-zero remote exit code is still a successful tool call: read exit_code, stdout and stderr. Newlines in command are kept (a multi-line command is copied to a remote temp script and removed after it exits). Use script instead of command for multi-line shell or python so you do not have to quote it. Interactive programs need pty:true; put answers in stdin, one line each, and do not paste them into command. If the process is still running at timeout (or a PTY has printed a prompt and gone quiet), the result has waiting:true and session_id. Continue with session_write, session_read and session_close. background:true returns task_id immediately; poll it with transfer_status. sudo:true runs the command under sudo -S using the password already saved for this server. Do not put that password in command or stdin. With sudo:true and pty:true, stdin is only the program input (for example the new password for passwd). username logs in as another user on the same host with the saved secret. Each call is a new shell; pass cwd when you need a directory. lc_c defaults to true (LC_ALL=C).

background.description: Return task_id immediately. Read output and exit_code later with transfer_status. Default false

command.description: Shell command. Newlines are preserved. Ignored when script is set

cwd.description: Remote working directory for this call only. Does not carry over to the next execute

lc_c.description: Set LC_ALL=C before the command so messages are English. Default true

pty.description: Allocate a pseudo-terminal. Required for passwd and other programs that read the terminal. Default false

script.description: Script body. Written to a remote temp file, executed, then deleted. Use this for multi-line shell or python

server_id.description: Server ID (configured server_id or host:port from quick_connect)

stdin.description: Data written to stdin, or to the PTY when pty is true. Include the newlines the program expects

sudo.description: Run under sudo -S -p '' with the password saved on this server. Do not pass the password yourself

timeout.description: Seconds to wait. If the process is still running, the call returns waiting:true instead of failing. Default 30

username.description: SSH user for this call. Same host, port and saved secret as server_id. Authentication failure is reported as 认证失败

name: execute
